PZZ700-191030-
122 PM PST Wed Nov 18 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1001 mb low was over the eastern Pacific Ocean at 
approximately 530 nautical miles west of San Fransisco, and a 
1025 mb high located about 700 nautical miles southwest of San 
Diego. Increasing westerly swell of 5 to 8 feet will occur on 
Thursday as a weather system approaches the region. This will also
bring increasing winds 20-30 kts as the front passes through,
highest winds on Thursday afternoon and early evening. There is a
10-15 percent chance of thunderstorms over the coastal waters 
Thursday afternoon. If any thunderstorms occur, they will be 
capable of producing gusty/erratic winds and lightning, with a 
slim chance of an isolated waterspout. Calmer winds and seas 
expected this weekend.

$$
